lede: Texas carries the stronger underlying team rating — +12.3 against +10.8, a 1.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Oklahoma +9.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Texas winning 74% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is running backs, where Texas leads Oklahoma by 120 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 89% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
